title: styled-components
description: CSS-in-JS library using tagged template literals for component-level styles.

data.text: styled-components is a CSS-in-JS library that lets you write actual CSS code inside your JavaScript components using tagged template literals. It generates unique class names and provides dynamic styling based on props.

data.title: Basic styled-component
data.content: Create a styled button component that accepts a primary prop.

terms.definition: A JavaScript feature allowing functions to parse template literals; styled-components uses this for CSS syntax.
A pattern where CSS is written directly in JavaScript files, scoped to individual components.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Write CSS directly in JavaScript using template literals
Dynamic styles based on component props
data.takeaway: styled-components combines the power of CSS with the flexibility of JavaScript.
